data.rationale: The proposal gets the right steps in the right order with the right parameters (city_a/city_b/country_b/month line up with hq_city/remote_city/country/month), but it says to send the email or save a draft instead of discarding it, which is wrong. It also hardcodes 'ahead' in the body text where the offset could go either way, and its holidays route through 'Calendar > Holidays' and 'filter to the target month' is a bit vague, so an automation built from this spec could take an unsafe, irreversible final step.
